verses.text: Again this Heavenly Sovereign Homuda's august child King Wake-nuke-futa-mata wedded his mother's younger sister Momo-shiki-iro-be, another name for whom was Her Augustness Oto-hime-ma-wake-hime, and begot children: Oho-iratsuko, another name for whom was King Ohohodo; next her Augustness Osaka-no-oho-naka-tsu-hime: next Tawi-no-naka-tsu-hime; next Tamiya-no-naka-tsu-hime; next Fujihara-no-koto-fushi-no-ira-tsume; next Queen Torime; next King Sane. Seven Kings and Queens. So King Oho-hodo was the ancestor of the Dukes of Mikuni, the Dukes of Hata, the Dukes of Okinaga, the Dukes of Sakahito of Sakata, the Dukes of Yamaji, the Dukes of Meta in Tsukushi, and the Dukes of Fuse. Again King Netori wedded his younger half-sister the Lady Mihara, and begot children: King Naka-tsu-hiko; next King Iwa-shiha Two Kings. Again the child of King Kata-shiha was King Kuni.
